### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/Tombonator3000/MOONSTONE/blob/d45943d9faed6cec36a2288eaa7144eee489db50/web/src/scenes.js#L186-L189 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Reset Trogg bake state when reusing a combat background** When a player revisits an arena with the same pristine background hash, `huskRenKamp()` returns early because `kampRen.hash` already matches, so this path calls `observerTrogg()` without clearing `troggKopi`, `troggEier`, or `troggBankData` from the previous fight. The same happens after loading a later-frame save. Subsequent blood or other deltas that coincide with a stale Trogg pixel can then be classified as current Trogg ownership and lose the original-delta protection, allowing an overlapping HD sprite to cover them. Clear the accumulated Trogg composition when a new pristine combat instance is encountered, even if its background hash is unchanged.
